4:18 AM EST, Tue Nov 3: S&P 500 futures fell 0.1% while Nasdaq-100 futures gained 0.24%. Apple shares declined 2% after reporting disappointing margins and missed iPad sales forecasts.
During standard trading, the Nasdaq Composite dropped 1.07% and the S&P 500 fell 0.51%. The Dow gained approximately 214 points (0.41%).
Prediction market traders estimate a "nearly 75% likelihood" of Democrats taking the Senate.
European stock markets opened broadly lower on Tuesday, with the regional Stoxx 600 index down 0.62% at the open.
